title: SvgSet
responsibility: Renders the native set element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgSet.children
inputs.description: An optional Svelte snippet for the native SVG <set> element's child content; it is rendered only when truthy. The implementation does not forward children as an attribute.

outputs.name: SvgSet
outputs.description: A native SVG <set> element with every prop except children forwarded as attributes and the children snippet rendered when truthy. It adds no wrapper element or other behavior.
